name: CloudGPU (npx)
description: Let an AI agent discover GPUs, get a cost quote, rent a GPU instance or run a job, upload and download files, read logs and shut it down, with spend, time and idle limits enforced server-side.

inputs.label: CloudGPU API Key
inputs.description: Optional. Without a key, the agent can call connect_account and the owner approves a key with a spending limit through a link.

obtain.instructions:
1. Go to cloudgpu.app/api
2. Sign in with Google or email
3. Create an API key and set its spending limit

auth.instructions: Optional: create a key at https://cloudgpu.app/api, or let the agent request an owner-approved key with connect_account.
